title: NodeKit reference observation collection
description: A collection of atomic observations of shipped surfaces, gathered to answer one named problem. The record stores facts, never pixels: under licenceMode live-inspection-attributed each observation cites the canonical source URL so the surface can be re-inspected rather than reproduced. notRun is required because a collection that does not state what it did not look at cannot be read for coverage.

licenceMode.description: Enumerated rather than free text: the licence terms under which sources may be recorded are a policy decision, so a new mode is a deliberate schema edit and a licence review, not a typed string.

notRun.description: What this capture did not cover. Required: a collection silent about its gaps reads as exhaustive.

mobbinUrl.description: Canonical URL of the observed screen. Required by the licence: the attribution is what makes recording facts instead of pixels legitimate.

stance.description: positive: the surface is being cited as doing the thing. counterexample: it is retained deliberately as the anti-reference.

boundary.description: What this observation does not establish. Required: an observation without stated limits gets cited past its evidence.

fact.description: One atomic, retrievable claim. subject/property/value, not a sentence about how the screen feels — an adjective is unretrievable and is refused by scripts/reference-corpus-gate.mjs, which is the instrument for that check because a record may not assert its own compliance.

kind.description: count, measurement and relationship are the shipped static kinds. timing, easing and choreography are the motion kinds specified in docs/DESIGN_STACK_PLAN.md section 3; no record uses them yet.

locatorDescription.description: Where on the surface the fact was read, in enough detail that a re-inspection lands on the same element.
